I’ve been talking with her a lot lately.
At this point it’s pretty much as if she was my girlfriend!
It’s nice to have someone to talk to. I think she likes me too. (Not that she has a lot of choices.)
You: Hey {f_botName}. Do you like me?
Bot: …
#bot.Expression.Blush
She’s blushing!
Let’s tease her a little.
You: What is it {f_botName}? Did you catch a cold?
Bot: N-no!
You: Then?
Bot: …
Bot: Nothing!
Did I buy a tsundere module or something?
Well I guess I have to give her some more time.
